team.name: Data Czars
team.mission: We build and support the Analytics Kernel and the Spark tooling that make data engineering in the Contoso Analytics Environment fast and safe.
team.pae: The Contoso Analytics Environment: JupyterHub notebooks on a shared Spark cluster, next to the data the analytics teams build on.
team.audience: Analysts and data engineers who write Python and Spark in the analytics environment.
team.officeHours: Thursdays, 2:00 to 3:00 PM, in the team's Teams channel

kernel.name: Analytics Kernel
kernel.summary: One shared Python kernel for the analytics environment, with Spark, the standard packages and the team's own package ready to use.
kernel.buildsOn: It builds on the environment's default kernel, so what works there works here.
setupSteps: Request the access under Get access, and wait until all of it is granted.
Open JupyterHub and start a new Terminal.
Run the install command from the kernel's docs.
Open a new notebook and pick Analytics Kernel.
kernel.firstSession:
from analytics import spark_session

spark = spark_session(profile="small")
spark.sql("show databases").show()

profiles.name: small
profiles.useWhen: Exploring, samples, and tables up to a few million rows.

profiles.name: medium
profiles.useWhen: Daily jobs and joins of tens of millions of rows.

profiles.name: large
profiles.useWhen: Wide joins and aggregations over hundreds of millions of rows.

profiles.name: wide-shuffle
profiles.useWhen: Jobs that shuffle far more than they read, such as many-way joins.

usageTool.name: Usage Tool
usageTool.summary: Counts who uses which reports and workspaces, and publishes the monthly usage reports.
howItWorks: Reads the environment's activity log once a day.
Rolls the activity up by report, workspace and team.
Writes one workbook per report type at the start of each month.

reportTypes.name: Workspace activity
reportTypes.description: Active users and refreshes per workspace.

usageTool.schedule: On the first working day of each month.
usageTool.outputLocation: A folder on the operator's laptop today.

fleet.summary: Several agents, one per repository, watched and answered from one window; data-czars and usage_tool are two of them.

faq.question: Spark says my Kerberos ticket has expired
faq.answer: Run kinit in a Terminal, then restart the kernel. If it asks for your password every session, reset the keyring as the kernel's docs say and store your credentials again.

faq.question: My job was killed for using too much memory
faq.answer: Start it again one profile up, or on wide-shuffle if it joins many tables. Get started > Pick a profile says what each one gives you.
